Review the R1 Story, Architecture, draft Spec, Task, and VibePro draft as one planning change.
Create R1 schema, fixture, source-lock, runtime, and tests only in a separate focused implementation change.
Regenerate implementation evidence at the exact combined HEAD before any completion or release decision.
Keep the existing .vibepro/config.json story registration in the six-file planning boundary; explicit --story-id remains isolated from current_story_id.

customer data, Personal body, secrets, credentials, and external sends

acceptance.statement: J0 PR #481, merge commit f8e7ac61349b326863feae5d7d3d8ae68e2b9d10, and implementation head 3fd71a1da59a85cb7cdc8cce8b17f22e3b767bde are recorded exactly; this task does not mark J0 done.

Artifact identity is artifact_id=sha256:<lowercase hex SHA-256(UTF-8(JCS(payload)))>, where payload contains the artifact schema version, exact J0 source lock, payload.run_id, and complete JudgmentDAGRunRecord; the stored envelope separately contains artifact_id, envelope.run_id, and payload, and artifact_id is never in the digest preimage.

Canonical serialization is RFC 8785 JCS with UTF-8 and no whitespace, preserves semantic J0 array order, fixes number and Unicode/string escaping behavior, rejects lone surrogates and other non-JSON values, and rejects cycles, unknown fields, wrong types, and truncation.

After pure JCS validation/digesting, save acquires a per-run exclusive reservation first; inside it, existing binding is checked, conflicting content is denied before temp creation, then temp envelope bytes are atomically renamed on the same filesystem and a create-once binding is made. Temporary and published-unbound/crash bytes are never completed artifacts and cross-filesystem atomic claim is not promised.

A first run_id binding is create-once; envelope.run_id, payload.run_id, and record.run_id must match exactly; same run_id with different content, digest, schema, source lock, or any run_id layer is a conflict with no existing artifact or binding mutation.

Reload verifies locator safety, exact stored envelope JCS bytes, payload-derived artifact_id, embedded and expected digest, exact source lock, equality of envelope/payload/record run_id, binding, and J0 record shape before returning a value; bindingless artifacts are rejected.
Reload returns a recursively deep-frozen snapshot isolated from caller, parser, and storage mutation.
Traversal, absolute path, NUL, dot segment, symlink, non-regular file, root escape, partial write, published-unbound crash state, cross-filesystem claim, and concurrent writer cases fail closed.

Future RED tests fail on the known pre-fix two-layer identity, JCS fixture, three-layer run_id, reservation ordering, crash visibility/cleanup, overwrite, integrity, filesystem, concurrency, and mutation behaviors before GREEN implementation.

This planning change modifies exactly six files: the five R1 planning files plus the existing .vibepro/config.json story registration; it creates no source-lock, schema, fixture, test, runtime, database, Graph, secret, customer, or deployment artifact. current_story_id affects only unspecified VibePro defaults; an explicit --story-id remains other-story-scoped.

A planned positive restart/reopen E2E saves a synthetic J0 record with store/process A, closes A, reopens the same root with fresh process/store B, reloads artifact_id, asserts exact original-record equality plus envelope/payload/record binding and J0 source-lock/schema equality, asserts recursive deep-freeze and mutation isolation, and records J0 runner invocation count as zero; no runtime or test is created in this planning task.

negative_evidence_contract.concurrent_writer_policy: pure JCS validation then per-run exclusive reservation; binding check before temp; same canonical content is idempotent; different content for one run_id is denied before artifact publication; last-write-wins is forbidden

identity_layers.digest_preimage: UTF-8(JCS(payload)) where payload has artifact_schema_version, j0_source_lock, run_id, and record; artifact_id is excluded
reload_checks: recompute artifact_id from payload and compare with stored and expected ids
compare stored envelope bytes with UTF-8(JCS(envelope)) byte-for-byte

canonical_fixtures: {\"s\":\"é\"} -> UTF-8 JCS bytes without unnecessary non-ASCII escaping

crash_state_policy.temporary: invisible to list/reload/binding; owner cleanup or future maintenance only
crash_state_policy.published_unbound: invisible completed artifact; same-run exact recovery may create binding; different request is denied; cleanup is future maintenance only

negative_evidence_contract.snapshot_policy: returned envelope and record are recursively deep-frozen and storage-independent

list.root_scope: all committed artifacts under the caller-owned artifact root; temporary and published-unbound states are excluded

error_codes.conflict: same run_id or published-unbound request has different canonical content, digest, schema, source lock, or binding
error_codes.invalid_artifact_id: artifact_id is not sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>
error_codes.invalid_path: absolute path, separator, NUL, dot segment, or URL scheme is supplied
error_codes.path_escape: resolved locator would leave the caller-owned artifact root
error_codes.schema_invalid: envelope, payload, record, JCS value, or schema version is invalid
error_codes.integrity_mismatch: stored bytes, canonical envelope, digest, or expected identity differs
error_codes.binding_missing_or_mismatch: binding is absent or does not point to requested artifact_id
error_codes.non_regular_file: locator resolves to a directory, device, FIFO, socket, or symlink
error_codes.cross_filesystem: reservation, binding, and artifact root have different devices
error_codes.not_found: no committed artifact is visible at the safe locator

fresh_process_protocol: process/store A seeds the artifact or crash fixture, records artifact bytes and binding bytes, then closes
fresh process/store B reopens the same root and performs exactly one save/reload/list operation
B asserts the exact code and result shape, record is absent on error, runner_invocations=0, and no repair/overwrite/delete occurred
B reads artifact and binding bytes again and asserts existing bytes and binding are unchanged

cases.fixture: stored envelope ends before the complete canonical JSON bytes
canonical envelope after rename with no binding
same-run exact envelope and missing binding
same run_id with different canonical envelope
unknown schema version or extra envelope field
binding points to a different artifact_id
no committed artifact at safe locator
dot or dot-dot segment in locator
reservation and artifact root on different device
temporary file in the artifact root
published-unbound file in the artifact root
temporary file at the requested locator

common_assertions: save/reload error result.record is null; list error result.items and result.count are null; success_record_returned is false for every error
artifact bytes, binding bytes, and committed artifact identity are unchanged
repair_attempted, overwrite_attempted, and delete_attempted are false
temporary list/reload cases return empty or not_found; published-unbound list/reload cases return empty or binding_missing_or_mismatch; neither state is a reload success value

required_suites: artifact envelope and J0 source-lock conformance
canonical digest and RFC 8785 JCS key-order/number/Unicode/lone-surrogate fixtures
per-run reservation ordering, atomic publish, partial write, crash states, and concurrent writer behavior
tamper, truncation, zero-byte, unknown version, and extra-field rejection
envelope/payload/record run_id equality and fail-closed mismatches
path traversal, symlink, non-regular file, and root containment negatives
recursive deep-freeze and caller/storage mutation isolation

positive restart/reopen E2E: process A saves a synthetic J0 record, closes; fresh process B reopens the same root, reloads artifact_id, asserts exact record/binding/source-lock/schema equality, deep-freeze and mutation isolation, and observes zero J0 runner invocations
machine-readable result envelope and stable error-code contract for every save/reload/list assertion

fresh-process negative E2E for tamper/truncate, published-unbound exact recovery and different-content denial, path escape, path syntax, cross-filesystem, non-regular file, and list/reload invisibility
required_assertion_units: every negative fixture asserts exact result code/status and record=null on error
every negative fixture asserts runner_invocations=0, no repair/overwrite/delete, and unchanged artifact/binding bytes
cross-filesystem, absolute path, NUL, slash/backslash separator, dot segment, URL scheme, symlink, and non-regular file are separate fixture assertions
published-unbound exact same-run recovery is distinct from different-content conflict; both assert no implicit cleanup
temporary and published-unbound artifacts are invisible to list and reload success values

runner version resolution, registry, migration, or compatibility decisions

baseline-candidate version comparison, scoring, or calibration
